CustomField.description: Pipeline Health: Scoring Reason - Partner Engaged. Momentum-written reason explaining the Partner Engaged milestone score.
CustomField.formula:
IF( Opportunity__r.Partner_Assist_Type__c = "Partner Sourced", "Opportunity sourced by " & Opportunity__r.Partner_Sourced__r.Name ,
IF( Opportunity__r.Partner_Assist_Type__c = "Partner Assisted", "Opportunity assisted by " & Opportunity__r.Partner_Assist__r.Name ,
"No partner engaged on this opportunity" ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Why this milestone got its score. Edit only to correct it.
CustomField.label: Scoring Reason - Partner Engaged
